title: Lunch at the Café
text:
Our class went to a small restaurant for lunch. The menu had pizza, pasta and chicken. Maria ordered pasta with cheese. I chose a chicken sandwich.

The drinks were water, juice and milk. Juice is my favorite drink. For dessert, we ate apple cake. The waiter was very friendly.

questions.text: What was the writer's favorite drink?
How did the class probably feel about the restaurant?
options: They were happy with the food and service
They were angry about the price
They were bored and wanted to leave
They were confused by the menu

questions.text: Why did the writer probably like the waiter?

vocabulary.definition: a list of the food and drinks in a restaurant
a person who brings food and drinks to your table in a restaurant
two slices of bread with food between them
kind and pleasant to be with

paragraph_translations: Nuestra clase fue a un pequeño restaurante a almorzar. El menú tenía pizza, pasta y pollo. María pidió pasta con queso. Yo elegí un sándwich de pollo.
Las bebidas fueron agua, jugo y leche. El jugo es mi bebida favorita. De postre, comimos pastel de manzana. El camarero era muy amable.
